[element-toc-entry]
=== `<toc-entry>` Table of Contents Entry

One entry in a structural Table of Contents.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-toc,`<toc>`>>, <<element-toc-div,`<toc-div>`>>, <<element-toc-entry,`<toc-entry>`>>
#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-title,`<title>`>> <<element-title,Title>>, zero or more <<element-subtitle,`<subtitle>`>> <<element-subtitle,Article Subtitle>>, zero or more Optionally any one of: <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-nav-pointer,`<nav-pointer>`>> <<element-nav-pointer,Navigation Pointer>> <<element-nav-pointer-group,`<nav-pointer-group>`>> <<element-nav-pointer-group,Navigation Pointer Group>> <<element-toc-entry,`<toc-entry>`>> <<element-toc-entry,Table of Contents Entry>>, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  toc-entry    %toc-entry-model;                            >
....

(label?, title*, subtitle*, (ext-link | nav-pointer | nav-pointer-group)?, (toc-entry)*)

....

 ...
 <toc>
  <toc-title-group>
   <title>Table of Contents</title>
  </toc-title-group>
  <toc-entry>
   <title>Foreword</title>
   <nav-pointer rid="fwd"/>
  </toc-entry>
  <toc-entry>
   <label>1</label>

  <toc-entry>
